mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM visit_types WHERE code = #{code} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, code, name, description, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM visit_types WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, code, name, description, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM visit_types WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visit_types (code, name, description, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE visit_types SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
